name: loong-lat-frontend
description: loong.lat: halaman depan dan tiga aplikasi frontend (dashboard, backoffice, driver) yang berjalan tanpa backend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n gateway,landing,console,backoffice,driver,api -c gray,cyan,blue,magenta,green,yellow "node scripts/dev-gateway.mjs" "npm -w @loong/landing run dev" "npm -w @loong/dashboard run dev" "npm -w @loong/backoffice run dev" "npm -w @loong/mobile run dev" "npm -w @loong/api-host run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w @loong/landing run build && npm -w @loong/dashboard run build && npm -w @loong/backoffice run build && npm -w @loong/mobile run build && npm -w @loong/api-host run build && node scripts/assemble-dist.mjs
